name: KingswayVideo Selector
author: morment

sections.description:
This plugin provides a Video Selector for KingswayVideo, allowing you to easily browse and select from the entire KingswayVideo library directly within WordPress. Streamline your workflow and save time with this efficient tool!

Arbitrary section

KingswayVideo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kingswayvideo-selector.zip file through the WordPress admin panel under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings page to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

Upload your videos to KingswayVideo at KingswayVideo Console, and seamlessly access them through the WordPress plugin.

What are the requirements for this plugin?

Download the plugin from the KingswayVideo Console.
